name: Ultra Ball
rules: Discard 2 cards, then search your deck for a Pokémon and put it into your hand.
whenGood: Core consistency for every Evolution deck.
whenBrick: Costs two discards — painful when hand is thin.

name: Nest Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench.
whenGood: Sets up Bench early without discarding.
whenBrick: Bricks mid/late when Bench is full or Basics are gone.

name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench.
whenGood: Best early Bench loader for 70 HP Basics.
whenBrick: Dead if no low-HP Basics left or Bench is full.

name: Rare Candy
rules: Evolve a Basic into a Stage 2, skipping Stage 1 (ignoring evolution timing).
whenGood: Turns on Stage 2 attackers one turn earlier.
whenBrick: Dead without matching Basic + Stage 2 in hand.

name: Boss's Orders
rules: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
whenGood: Prize mapping and KO sequencing.
whenBrick: Wasted without a KO follow-up or when Bench is empty.

name: Counter Catcher
rules: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, switch in 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
whenGood: Comeback gust when behind on prizes.
whenBrick: Illegal / blank when ahead or tied on prizes.

name: Iono
rules: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws cards equal to prizes remaining.
whenGood: Refills your hand and wrecks theirs mid-game.
whenBrick: Can refill an opponent who was bricked.

name: Professor's Research
rules: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.
whenGood: Raw redraw when the hand is disposable.
whenBrick: Discards key pieces you still needed.

name: Arven
rules: Search your deck for an Item and a Pokémon Tool and put them into your hand.
whenGood: Fetches ACE SPEC / Tool + consistency Item in one supporter.
whenBrick: Soft if you need draw more than tutor.

name: Crispin
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Energy and a Basic Energy of a different type; attach one and put the other into your hand.
whenGood: Dual-type ramp for Dragapult / multi-energy attackers.
whenBrick: Blank if you only run one Energy type.

name: Night Stretcher
rules: Put a Pokémon or Basic Energy from your discard pile into your hand.
whenGood: Recovers discarded attackers and Energy.
whenBrick: Dead if discard is empty of targets.

name: Earthen Vessel
rules: Discard a card from your hand. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy and put them into your hand.
whenGood: Fast Energy tutor after a discard.
whenBrick: Needs a discardable card in hand.

name: Super Rod
rules: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy from your discard pile into your deck.
whenGood: Recycles prized/discarded resources for long games.
whenBrick: Slow when you need immediate hand cards.

name: Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
whenGood: Retreat without paying Energy; pivots into attackers.
whenBrick: Dead with empty Bench.

name: Pokégear 3.0
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck; you may take a Supporter into your hand.
whenGood: Finds Boss/Iono/Research on curve.
whenBrick: Misses if Supporters are deep or already in hand.

name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and put it into your hand.
whenGood: Budget Pokémon search when Ultra Ball density is low.
whenBrick: 50% miss rate — unreliable.

name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
whenGood: Repositions Energy after KOs or onto a fresh attacker.
whenBrick: Dead without Energy on board.

name: Crushing Hammer
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
whenGood: Slows single-Energy attackers and Tools-on-Energy lines.
whenBrick: Coin-flip Item — often a brick.

name: Unfair Stamp
rules: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 2 cards. During your opponent's next turn, they can't play Item cards.
whenGood: Locks Item-heavy decks after a decisive KO turn.
whenBrick: Soft vs decks that do not lean on Items.

name: Secret Box
rules: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
Discard 3 cards. Search your deck for an Item, a Supporter, a Stadium, and a Tool; put them into your hand.
whenGood: One-card toolbox grab for combo turns.
whenBrick: Costs 3 discards — catastrophic on thin hands.
